description: Scaleway's OpenAPI export drops query parameters that belong to a proto `oneOf`, and `ListConsumptionLimits` loses the one it requires. Live on 2026-10-12, `GET /generative-apis/v1/consumption-limits` with neither answered 400 `invalid_arguments` (`organization_project_id`: "value is required"), and `?project_id=<uuid>` or `?organization_id=<uuid>` each answered 200. There is no official JS SDK package for this API to cross-check against.

traits.smithy.api#documentation: List the consumption limits of this Organization. One-of `organization_project_id`: exactly one of `organization_id`, `project_id` — the API rejects a call with neither.
List the consumption limits of this Project. One-of `organization_project_id`: exactly one of `organization_id`, `project_id` — the API rejects a call with neither.
